tasks.label: Open Current File in External Viewer (Brave / LeoCAD)
tasks.command: case "${fileExtname}" in .html|.htm) setsid -f /usr/bin/brave-browser "${file}" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; .md|.markdown) uv run --with markdown python "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/md_to_brave.py" "${file}" ;; .ldr|.mpd) setsid -f /usr/bin/leocad -l /usr/share/ldraw "${file}" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *) setsid -f /usr/bin/xdg-open "${file}" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac
